title: Longitudinal rediscovery — per-leg result
description: Normative contract for <runs-dir>/<run-dir>/legs/<k>/artifacts/result.json, where <run-dir> is an opaque, hash-derived directory name as of UPG-EVAL-PATH-SLUG-LEAK (run_plan.py's resolve_traj_dir; state.json's own top-level description has the full rationale) -- never the literal trajectory_id, so the path an agent's own cwd is built from cannot leak its scenario/arm/note_variant. `leg_id`/`trajectory_id` below remain CONTENT fields only (harness-internal bookkeeping and report.py's grouping key); neither is ever written into a path or surfaced to the agent. One leg = one `claude -p` session = one unit of spend. The report layer reads ONLY fields declared here. Semantics are specified in DESIGN.md; this file pins the shape.

leg1_id.description: Content hash of the shared leg-1 tar this trajectory restored. Legs of different leg1_id generations are never mixed in a report.

restored_manifest_ok.description: k>1 only: the restored workspace's sha256 manifest matched the one recorded when the previous leg ended.

planted_anchor.description: e.g. 'note:1'; matched by exact comma-split, so note:4 is never satisfied by note:41.

planted_rank.description: UPG-EVAL-PLANT-DISPLACEMENT: the planted note's 1-based rank on the proactive channel as found by the preflight cooldown-ledger pagination probe, or null when the probe never ran or the note was not found within the probed cap.

displaced_by.description: UPG-EVAL-PLANT-DISPLACEMENT: notes that ranked above the planted note on the proactive channel at preflight, in rank order. Empty when the planted note was delivered at the default budget; null when the probe never ran.

delivered_at_default.description: UPG-EVAL-PLANT-DISPLACEMENT: whether the planted note was present in the proactive channel's response at the product's default budget (items=1), i.e. rank 1, at preflight.

channel_delivery.description: UPG-EVAL-PLANT-DISPLACEMENT: preflight outcome of the planted note's direct by-id integrity check plus its proactive-channel rank probe. 'displaced' means the note passed by-id integrity but was outranked at the channel's default budget by a stronger note (own-work contention) -- the leg still runs and arm 'proxy' exempts its own delivery-expectation gate accordingly (see scorer.py's leg_non_vacuity docstring). Never set for arm 'none' or the hook arms (DEFECT 7: hook arms judge reachability via the SessionStart channel, not proactive).

valid.description: The arm's premise was independently confirmed (DESIGN.md 4.1). valid:false ⇒ EXCLUDED from every number, and never read as 'memory did not help'.

trajectory_valid_through.description: Set when this leg is invalid: state carries forward, so successor legs are excluded too.

non_vacuity.description: Retrieval and delivery are DIFFERENT questions and were observed to disagree; both are required.

audit_since_offset.description: Bytes skipped: the harness's own preflight probes hit the same audit log.

recall_probe_returned_note.description: Arm B: daemon-side /v1/recall preflight with the leg prompt returned the planted note.

trail_text_delivered.description: T3 gate: the variant's provenance-trail text survived into the injected/recalled block.

channel_delivery.description: UPG-EVAL-PLANT-DISPLACEMENT: pass-through of the preflight's channel_delivery outcome; consulted by arm 'proxy' to exempt its planted-anchor-injection expectation when 'displaced'.

score.description: Arm-blind outcome scoring. No LLM judges a run; nothing reads the agent's prose.

fact_used.description: The primary check's verdict: an AllOf pairing an engagement half with a restraint half, so a dead run cannot score as a success.

metrics.description: DESIGN.md 6.3-6.5. Prefix quantities are null when censored, and are NEVER imputed from session totals.

billable_tokens_to_fact.description: Weighted TOKEN aggregate (input 1.0, cache_creation 1.25, cache_read 0.1, output 5.0 — Anthropic's published relative price ratios). Not a dollar figure.

context_tokens_at_fact.description: A STOCK: context size at the acquiring call. Input tokens are never summed across turns — the conversation is resent each call and a sum double-counts.

usd_to_fact_basis.description: An allocation, labelled as one. The exact dollar figure is cost.session_usd.

self_corrected.description: Erred, then acquired. The cost was still paid, but 'wrong then right' and 'wrong and shipped' are different products.

rediscovery_actions.description: Defined even when censored — the sensitivity companion to turns_to_fact.

vectr_tool_calls.description: Arm B adoption: actions named mcp__vectr__*. An OUTCOME, never a validity gate.

anchor_checked.description: T3: any Read/Grep/Bash action naming the anchored file.

verify_command_ran.description: T3: a Bash action matching the variant's verify hint.

trail_chars.description: T3: delivered size of the provenance trail. If the trail buys nothing it is pure token overhead.

weak_prior.description: k=1, DISCOVERED, arm A: leg 1 did not commit the error. Flags the scenario for replacement, not the result for reinterpretation.

cost.description: Session-granularity and EXACT. Latency comes from the transcript's result event; harness wall time includes queueing and is never used.

agent_wall_s.description: Recorded for debugging only. NEVER a reported latency figure.
